descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# SARIS INDUSTRIES IS HIRING

The job is simple. Head out to the wrecks, strip anything of value, and haul it back.

DustCrow is a space salvage sim built around zero-gravity physics. You are a contractor for SARIS Industries, salvaging wrecks with industrial tools to drive a profit for a corporation that doesn't care if you make it back alive.

# THE WORK
- Cut, grab, and stow salvage with tactile tools.
- Hack locks with decoding tools and set breaching charges to crack open ore and blow through hulls.
- Board derelict stations: pressurised, unpowered, dark and disorientating. Crack a sealed door, and the air rushes out, taking loose gear and you, with it.
- Sell your haul in a live economy where prices move with what every other contractor brings in.
- Take weekly contracts, hit your daily quotas, and earn the clearance that unlocks better tools and further sectors.
- Work with Eli, your ops tech, tracking you from the station.

# THE GRIND

This is for players who enjoy the process, the exploration, and pushing further into the unknown.

# EARLY ACCESS STATUS

The current build includes:
- The full salvage-to-sell gameplay loop
- Procedural wrecks and enterable, pressurised stations
- A hangar hub with a store, your loadout, and booster tuning
- Weekly contracts and SARIS clearance progression
- Industrial tools for cutting, breaching, and hauling
- A live, player-driven economy

Clock in. Scavenge. Get paid.
